title: Finite constant pushforward H1 lifting and naturality
statement: Let A be a henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], f:Y→Spec A proper, and i:Y₀→Y its cartesian closed residue fibre [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let Λ be a commutative ring, J any sheaf of Λ-modules on Y [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], h:V→Y finite and locally of finite presentation, M a finite Λ-module, and ψ:h_*underline M→J. For every x in H¹(Y₀,i⁻¹(h_*underline M)) [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], there exists z in H¹(Y,h_*underline M) such that H¹(i⁻¹ψ)(x) is the restriction of H¹(ψ)(z), using the canonical comparison between module inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and underlying abelian inverse image. Injectivity of J is not assumed.

proof.text: Form the pullback V₀ of the finite map h along the residue fibre i, and paste its cartesian square with the proper henselian residue-fibre square. The composite V→Spec A is proper by finite-morphism permanence. Apply the henselian constant-sheaf H1 comparison to V. Finite exchange and the bijective edge maps identify the H1 restriction for h_* of the constant abelian sheaf with this surjective constant-sheaf restriction, using cohomology_edgeMap_baseChange. This proves restriction_finite_constant.

Forget the finite constant module to its additive group. constantCommuteCompose identifies the underlying constant module sheaf with the corresponding constant abelian sheaf, and direct image commutes with this forgetting by the presheaf associator. Naturality of cohomology pullback transports the preceding surjectivity through this isomorphism. By the canonical module-to-abelian inverse-image comparison, its map on H1 is bijective. Lift the given x first through that comparison and then through the surjective restriction to obtain z.

The canonical comparison is natural in the module sheaf: apply left and right naturality of the abelian adjunction hom equivalence to the module unit naturality for ψ. CohomologyMap_map identifies the restriction of H1(ψ)(z) with the inverse-image map of the restriction of z. Substitute the two lifting equalities, apply Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply twice, and use this comparison naturality. The resulting equality is exactly the conclusion.
